_note: SOURCE OF TRUTH for retailer directory. Every claim must be traceable to the linked official page fetched on the stated date. Summaries are paraphrases — the linked official page controls.

retailers.name: Blue Nile
retailers.contact: US: +1-800-242-2728 · Email: service@bluenile.com · Live chat, WhatsApp, virtual appointments, showrooms (see Contact page).
retailers.returns_summary: 30-day money-back guarantee: eligible items in original, unworn condition may be returned within 30 days from the shipment date for refund or exchange. NOT eligible: personalized jewelry, custom orders, engraved items, items resized after initial purchase, Diamond Upgrade Program purchases, clearance and 'Final Sale' items. Two complimentary returns per customer per year; Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) required; missing diamond grading report replacement costs $150.
retailers.jewelry_notes: Product pages state a limited lifetime warranty on gold/platinum jewelry items with purchase price of $1,000+ against manufacturer's defect (limitations apply). Credit-card financing ('Blue Nile Credit Card') advertised on product pages; returns page also references PayPal and bank-wire refunds. Full payment options live at checkout — confirm there.
evidence_quotes: Two complimentary returns are allowed per customer, per year.
A Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) number is required for all returns.

retailers.name: Costco
retailers.contact: Costco Customer Service: https://customerservice.costco.com/ (linked from Costco product pages as 'Contact Customer Service'). Warehouse membership counter for in-person help.
retailers.returns_summary: Jewelry bought on Costco.com may be returned for a refund including all shipping and handling fees — at any warehouse (bring IGI/GIA certificates) or by arranged mail pickup. Diamonds over 1.00 carat receive a Jewelry Credit Memo and Graduate Gemologist authenticity inspection: allow 3–5 business days (warehouse) or up to 2 weeks (mail). Product pages cite a risk-free 100% satisfaction guarantee 'with some exceptions and limitations' — read the full official return policy before purchase.
retailers.jewelry_notes: Finished jewelry only — no loose stones or semi-mounts. Majority in 14kt gold, 18kt gold, or 950 platinum. Costco does not clean or resize jewelry and cannot customize metal beyond what is offered. All 14kt/18kt white gold is rhodium plated (noted on product pages). Items $500+ ship insured with signature delivery.
evidence_quotes: You may return jewelry purchased on Costco.com for a refund including all shipping and handling fees.
Costco does not clean or resize jewelry.
